title: Sources: neocloud Fluidstack closed a $1.5B round led by Jane Street at an $18B+ valuation; in July, the startup announced a $750M round at a $7.5B valuation (Iain Martin/Forbes)
summary: Iain Martin / Forbes: Sources: neocloud Fluidstack closed a $1.5B round led by Jane Street at an $18B+ valuation; in July, the startup announced a $750M round at a $7.5B valuation — A little-known company called Fluidstack has become a test bed for Google's plans to sell its own AI chip.
